label: prop:descartes-elliptic-curve
title: The Descartes elliptic curve $\mathcal{E}_q$
html:
Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be the Descartes universe with \chi(A) = -6 and substrate parameter q. Set s = \sqrt{q}. The color elliptic fiber (color elliptic) of Bring's surface at spacetime ratio z = s - s^{-1} is the elliptic curve

  \mathcal{E}_q  : 
  y^2 =  x^3
  +  \frac{2s^4 + s^3 - 2s^2 - s + 2}{3s^2}x
  +  \frac{5(s^2 + s - 1)(4s^4 - s^3 - 4s^2 + s + 4)}{27s^3}

with Weierstrass coefficients expressible directly in q:

  p(q) = 
  \frac{2(q^2 - q + 1)}{3q}
  +  \frac{q - 1}{3\sqrt{q}},
  r(q) = 
  \frac{20(q - 1)^3}{27q^{3/2}}
  +  \frac{5(q - 1)^2}{9q}
  +  \frac{5(\sqrt{q} - 1/\sqrt{q})}{9}
  +  \frac{20}{27}.
